start: Enquiries screen; an open enquiry a member invited; the gym set free days in Settings → Member app; the member has a plan running; set-up: largest font

steps.action: Set the device font to its largest size, then do "Bring a friend thank-you".

must_not: Text cut off, text over other text, or the main button pushed out of reach
